an2.52:1.1: bhikkhave puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an2.52:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammā sambuddho rājā ca cakkavattī.
an2.52:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan ti. 2. Dve 'me
an2.53:1.1: bhikkhave puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā.
an2.53:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammā sambuddho rājā ca cakkavattī.
an2.53:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā ti. 3.

an2.54:1.3: Tathāgatassa ca arahato sammā sambuddhassa rañño ca cakkavattissa.
an2.54:1.4: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hotī ti. 4. Dve 'me

an2.56:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammā sambuddho paccekabuddho ca.

an2.59:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve asaniyā phalantiyā na santasantī ti. 9. Dve 'me
an2.60:1.1: bhikkhave atthavase sampassamānā kimpurisā mānusiṃ vācaṃ na bhāsanti.
an2.60:1.3: Mā ca musā bhaṇimhā mā ca paraṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhimhā ti.

an2.61:1.4: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṃ karotī ti. 11. Asantasannivāsañ ca
an2.62:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī ti.
an2.62:1.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccasosuṃ.
an2.62:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave asanta-sannivāso hoti kathañ ca asanto sannivasanti?
an2.62:2.2: Idha bhikkhave therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
an2.62:2.3: Thero pi maṃ na vadeyya majjhimo pi maṃ na vadeyya navo pi maṃ na vadeyya
an2.62:2.4: theram p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ majjhimam p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ navam p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.5: Thero ce pi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī no ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheseyyam pi naṃ passam pi' ssa na paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.6: Majjhimo ce pi maṃ vadeyya navo ce pi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī no ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheseyyam pi naṃ passam pi' ssa na paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.7: Majjhimassa pi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:-- pe . . . Navassa pi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
an2.62:2.8: Thero pi maṃ na vadeyya majjhimo pi maṃ na vadeyya navo pi maṃ na vadeyya
an2.62:2.9: theram p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ majjhimam p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ navam p' ahaṃ na vadeyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.10: Thero ce pi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī no ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheseyyam pi naṃ passam pi' ssa na paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.11: Majjhimo ce pi maṃ vadeyya . . . navo ce pi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī no ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheseyyaṃ pi nam passam pi' ssa na paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:2.12: Evam kho bhikkhave asantasannivāso hoti evañ ca asanto sannivasanti.
an2.62:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave santasannivāso hoti? Kathañ ca santo sannivasanti?
an2.62:3.2: Idha bhikkhave therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:.
an2.62:3.3: Thero pi maṃ vadeyya majjhimo pi maṃ vadeyya navo pi maṃ vadeyya
an2.62:3.4: theraṃ p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ majjhimam p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ navam p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.5: Thero ce pi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī sadhū ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheseyyaṃ passaṃ pi' ssa paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.6: Majjhimo ce pi maṃ vadeyya navo ce pi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī sādhū ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheseyyaṃ passam pi' ssa paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.7: Majjhimassa pi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:-- pe . . . Navassa pi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
an2.62:3.8: Thero pi maṃ vadeyya majjhimo pi maṃ vadeyya navo pi maṃ vadeyya
an2.62:3.9: theram p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ majjhimam p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ navam p' ahaṃ vadeyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.10: Thero ce pi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī sādhū ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheseyyam passam pi' ssa paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.11: Majjhimo ce pi maṃ vadeyya navo ce pi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī sādhū ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheseyyam passam pi' ssa paṭikareyyaṃ.
an2.62:3.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave santasannivāso hoti evañ ca santo sannivasantī ti. 12.
an2.63:1.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe ubhato vacīsaṃsāro diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi ajjhattaṃ avūpasantaṃ hoti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an2.63:1.2: dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ viharissanti.
an2.63:2.1: Yasmiñ ca kho bhikkhave adhikaraṇe ubhato vacīsaṃsāro diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi ajjhattaṃ suvūpasanto hoti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an2.63:2.2: na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca phāsuṃ viharissantī ti. 1.
